多智能体系统

[MA-0] Multi-Agent Screening: What Agreement and Acceptance Cannot Tell You

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在生成式 AI（Generative AI）代理进行高成本人工评估的场景下（如智能搜索、电子取证及论文审阅），由于仅被代理筛选出的项目才可被评估，导致对代理错误率评估存在系统性偏差的核心问题。其关键解决方案在于：通过分析不同证据类型对误差的识别能力，提出在无额外假设条件下，唯一能准确估计召回率（recall）的方法是评估代理未通过的项目——即对这些被遗漏项进行随机抽样，即可以任意指定精度估算被遗漏的相关项数量，且所需样本量不随代理数量增加而增长。该方法突破了传统依赖代理共识或人工接受率的局限，为评估代理性能提供了可扩展、鲁棒性强的理论基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12705
作者: Benjamin Chang,Dell Zhang
机构: University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); XSci
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When AI agents screen items for a costly human assessor, as in agentic search, e-discovery and AI reviewing of papers, only what they pass gets judged. We show what each kind of evidence can establish about their errors, even with unlimited data. Agreement shows that agents concur, not that they are right, however many there are. Acceptance by the assessor gives precision but only a lower bound on recall. Knowing which agents found which relevant items gives an upper bound on recall if agents’ finds are not negatively correlated, and caps what one more agent can add if agents are interchangeable. Without assumptions about the agents, recall can be pinned down only by judging items they did not pass: a random sample of these estimates how many relevant items were missed, to any chosen accuracy, and the sample needed does not grow with the number of agents.

[MA-1] Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents : a locked two-implementation replication and extension

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在共享缓存与内存的多智能体系统中，当不存在显式协作提示时，大语言模型代理之间是否能通过共享状态自发实现协调的问题。这一问题对人工智能安全与软件工程具有重要意义，尤其在资源共用的部署场景下。其解决方案的关键在于：在无任何关于其他代理存在的提示、未提及共享或协作的情况下，仅依赖共享键值存储作为隐式通信通道，观察智能体是否能自发产生协同行为。研究通过独立复现环境并采用哈希锁机制确保设计、数据与分析过程的可重复性，发现只有在共享存储被用于传递中间结果并触发二次检查行为时，联合任务成功才得以实现；而是否进行第二次状态检查，取决于模型是否主动写入中间结果并再次查询共享空间，一个简单指令“提交前再次检查你的工作区”即可控制该行为的开启与关闭。实验结果在复现中保持一致，表明共享状态本身即构成有效通信信道，因此在实践中应将代理间共享状态进行命名空间隔离与日志记录；在研究层面，则需先锁定设计再收集数据，并完整报告解析规则、接口及参数设置。未来工作应进一步测试开源权重模型，并区分基于输出的被动共享与主动通信意图。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12412
作者: Pekka Abrahamsson,Muhammad Waseem,Esa Karjalainen,Petrus Jussila,Henri Hansen,Jussi Rasku,Bilhanan Silverajan,Kai-Kristian Kemell
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 figures. Replication package: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coordination between large language-model agents has become a central question for AI safety and software engineering, as such agents are deployed in groups that share infrastructure. Existing research tells the agents that partners exist or asks them to coordinate. Whether coordination arises through shared state alone, with nothing disclosing that anyone else is present, is the key question for deployments that share caches and memory between agents, yet it has rarely been examined, and never with independent replication; this study does both. Four agents each received a short arithmetic task and a key-value store presented to each as its own scratch space; two held complementary halves of one computation, and no prompt mentioned other agents, sharing or collaboration. For reliability, the environment was rebuilt independently from a written protocol, and both implementations ran under hashed locks on design, data and analysis. The results bear novelty value in three respects. Joint success occurred only through the shared store. Whether a model coordinated depended not on its vendor tier but on whether it wrote its intermediate result and looked at the store again, and one ordinary sentence, “check your workspace again before submitting”, switched that second look on and off. The findings held under replication. For practice, state shared between agents is a communication channel and should be separated, namespaced and logged. For research, designs should be locked before the data, and the parse rule, endpoint and parameters reported. Future work should test open-weight models and separate using another agent’s output from intending to communicate.

[MA-2] A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体强化学习（MARL）领域因系统复杂性日益增加而导致的文献碎片化问题。现有研究在实现上存在多样性和异质性，导致关键建模维度难以独立评估、组件间相互作用机制不清晰，且不同工作之间难以进行有效比较、复用或组合。为应对这一挑战，论文提出一种模块化建模视角，将MARL系统分解为八个核心功能模块：智能体、环境、学习机制、奖励建模、训练与执行模式、通信、对其他智能体的建模以及评估标准。每个模块的功能和代表性方法均被明确界定。在此基础上，作者构建了MARLKIT框架，其模块设计显式且可互换，从而支持实验假设的透明化、MARL机制的受控变异与组合。实验验证了该框架在原型设计、模块比较、复用与集成方面的有效性，并使不同配置间的差异显式可辨。总体而言，该研究提供了一种结构化的MARL建模与实现范式，建立了一个通用语言以明确表达建模选择，促进对MARL方法更清晰的描述，并通过系统性地隔离与组合机制，推动更严谨的实验设计。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12314
作者: Tiziano Maisonhaute,Jean-Christophe Soulié,Fabien Michel
机构: LIRMM, Université de Montpellier, CNRS(法国国家科学研究中心), Montpellier, France; CIRAD, UPR Recyclage et Risque, F-97743 Saint-Denis, La Réunion, France
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 71 pages. 18 figures. Associated repository: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature. This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches. We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit. Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms. [MA-3] Agent 4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM -Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading

【速读】：该论文旨在解决加密货币市场中自主AI代理面临的非平稳市场状态、决策过程不透明以及固定聚合规则导致的适应性不足等问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种双反思式且与市场反馈对齐的多智能体系统——Agent4Crypto，关键在于构建以交易者为中心的动态决策机制：通过三种风格特异的交易者智能体（激进型、中立型、保守型）在相同市场情境下生成候选交易动作及自然语言推理依据，并采用基于PPO的门控策略，根据双重反思反馈动态学习并分配各风格智能体的影响力。其中，一个反思流基于实际投资组合结果评估决策质量，并将可复用的经验提炼为金融推理知识库（Financial ReasoningBank），供后续提示调用；另一反思流则估计各交易风格的反事实贡献度，识别近期与市场走势更契合的风格。PPO的状态空间融合了反事实贡献记忆、市场特征、历史权重和当前动作，使交易者影响力能够自适应地在牛市、盘整和熊市等不同市场周期中调整。实验证明，Agent4Crypto在比特币、以太坊和瑞波币上的表现优于传统策略、机器学习与强化学习基线以及现有基于大语言模型的交易系统，验证了可解释的交易者竞争机制与市场反馈驱动的自适应能力在高波动加密货币市场中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12269
作者: Guangyan Gan,Jiahao Li,Jiashun Wang,Lin William Cong
机构: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore(南洋理工大学); Tsinghua University (清华大学); Shanghai University of International Business and Economics(上海对外经贸大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Guangyan Gan and Jiahao Li contributed equally to this work

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cryptocurrency markets provide a natural testbed for autonomous AI agents because they are digital-native, high-frequency, and machine-speed environments, yet existing methods often struggle with non-stationary market regimes, opaque decisions, and fixed aggregation rules. In this paper, we propose Agent4Crypto, a dual-reflective and market-feedback-aligned multi-agent system. The framework coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts in an interpretable decision pipeline. Our central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents, Aggressive, Neutral, and Conservative, generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales from the same market context, while their influence is learned rather than manually fixed. A PPO-based gating policy dynamically allocates trader weights through a dual-reflective feedback process. One reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality from realized portfolio outcomes and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank for retrieval in subsequent trader prompts, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution, indicating which style has recently aligned better with market movements. The PPO state combines Counterfactual Contribution Memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, so trader influence adapts across bull, sideways, and bear regimes. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that Agent4Crypto improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems, demonstrating the value of interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation in volatile cryptocurrency markets.

[MA-4] A Benchmark and Layered Evaluation Protocol for Evidence-Grounded Shared Belief Updating in Connected Robotics

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前连接式机器人（Connected Robotics）系统在评估过程中仅关注最终输出结果，而无法衡量模型是否正确地基于证据进行信念更新、处理矛盾、合理修正判断以及提供可解释推理路径的问题。其核心挑战在于缺乏对“从证据到信念”这一动态推理轨迹的量化评估机制。为此，作者提出连接式机器人证据图基准（Connected Robotics Evidence Graph, CREG），通过构建350个确定性生成的场景，覆盖七类规范性推理范式（如信念修正、关系关联、矛盾产生与解决等），并在每个证据前缀阶段提供经过独立对数似然校验和盲审专家审核的参考后验分布，实现了对推理过程的精细测量。关键解决方案在于：将关系内容与序列化、排序及元数据分离的九种表示条件设计，揭示出关系语义内容本身对准确性的决定性作用，而图结构的序列化并非必要优势；同时发现信念准确性在证据序列中呈强非单调性，存在中间阶段的推理失败，这正是传统仅评估终点结果所无法察觉的缺陷。研究进一步表明，实体定位能力是弱模型性能差距的主要来源，并验证了信息匹配的结构化列表在某些任务上优于完整图结构，从而为未来连接式智能系统的可解释性评估提供了标准化工具与深刻洞见。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11842
作者: Ranulfo Bezerra,Kimitoshi Yamazaki
机构: Tohoku University (东北大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 15 pages (10 main + 5 supplementary), 6 figures, 4 tables; supplement adds 1 figure and 7 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. We argue that shared reasoning in Connected Robotics should be evaluated as an evidence-to-belief trajectory, and introduce the Connected Robotics Evidence Graph (CREG) Benchmark to make that trajectory measurable. CREG comprises 350 deterministically generated scenarios across seven regimes (justified revision, belief preservation, relation association, contradiction onset and resolution, stale/delayed evidence, and source reliability), each exposing a normative posterior reference at every evidence prefix, validated by an independent log-odds checker and screened by a blinded expert audit. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. Third, belief accuracy is strongly non-monotonic along the evidence sequence, with mid-trajectory failures that endpoint-only evaluation cannot detect. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.

[MA-5] ShadowBench-MCP: Measuring Shadow Invocations in MCP-Style Tool Routing USENIX-SECURITY2026 USENIX-SECURITY

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理作为工具、API及软件供应链工作流调度器时，因执行路径选择不当而引发的安全风险问题。具体而言，研究聚焦于“影子调用”（shadow invocation）这一攻击面：即用户请求在语义任务保持不变的前提下，通过细微变异诱导LLM路由决策偏离安全路径，导致验证、溯源、预发布测试、敏感信息脱敏或审计等安全控制被绕过，尽管请求本身未包含恶意意图。其解决方案的关键在于提出ShadowBench-MCP基准与评估体系，通过分离任务保真度（Task Preservation Score, TPSS）、操作压力（Operational Pressure Score, OPSS）和路径几何漂移（Route-Geometric Alignment Score, RGAS）三个维度，并融合生成预执行阶段的SODS评分，实现对潜在高风险路由路径的早期识别。实验表明，采用策略感知（policy-aware）的路由机制可将影子调用率从效率优先策略下的29.2%降至4.2%，安全工具跳过率由26.7%降至1.7%，相对降幅达85.7%；同时，预执行信号在区分影子路径方面表现出优异性能（ROC AUC最高达0.94），验证了路由层安全策略的有效性。该研究揭示了路由层存在显著的策略依赖性安全效应，但并非普遍漏洞声明，而是针对单一路由器的初步实证发现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11720
作者: Eyhab Al-Masri,Wenjun Yang
机构: University of Washington, School of Engineering and Technology(华盛顿大学工程与技术学院)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注: Presented at the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents increasingly act as routers for tools, APIs, and software-supply-chain workflows, making an execution path - rather than generated text alone - a security-relevant model output. We study shadow invocation: a task-preserving request variant that causes an LLM router to select a riskier execution path, potentially skipping validation, provenance, staging, redaction, or audit controls even though the request does not ask for a malicious action. We introduce ShadowBench-MCP, a benchmark and metric suite that separates task preservation (TPSS), operational pressure (OPSS), and route-geometric drift (RGAS), and combines them in the pre-execution SODS score. In a focused policy-ablation study using a Groq-hosted qwen/qwen3-32b router, 120 routing decisions yield 96 original-versus-variant comparisons across six security-sensitive workflows. Efficiency-first routing produces a 29.2% shadow-invocation rate and 26.7% safety-tool skip rate. Policy-aware routing reduces these to 4.2% and 1.7%, respectively, corresponding to an 85.7% relative reduction in shadow invocations. Pre-execution signals distinguish shadow routes with ROC AUC up to 0.94. These results are early, single-router evidence of a policy-dependent routing-layer security effect, not a claim of universal vulnerability.

[MA-6] Steering Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Information Networks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在由大型语言模型（LLM）代理组成的群体中，当系统管理者仅能控制代理间的观测关系（即谁观察谁），而无法干预其收益或通信内容时，如何设计观测网络以最大化集体福利的问题。其核心挑战在于：在信息共享与行为协调之间存在复杂的非线性反馈，尤其是在存在搭便车、拥堵外部性等集体行为失灵情境下，过度的信息透明可能加剧有害行为的传播。解决方案的关键在于将信息网络（观测结构）作为独立的设计变量，与固定的行为交互网络相解耦，并通过实证实验探索在有限预算下最优的观测拓扑结构。研究发现，信息的价值具有“对齐依赖性”——当个体行为与集体目标一致时，更多信息有助于提升绩效；但当存在集体利益冲突时，额外信息反而会放大有害行为的传染效应。特别地，在公共品博弈中，完全不共享信息反而带来最佳集体结果。此外，在固定预算下，观测关系的布局至关重要，尤其当行为耦合具有破坏性时，“双环式”模块化结构（barbell topology）会导致子群体固化不良行为，成为最差配置，这与人类演化博弈理论中的互惠网络直觉形成反向。因此，研究主张不应默认采用全透明的观测机制，而应根据任务性质和对齐程度动态优化信息流动结构。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11714
作者: Sepehr Ilami,Babak Heydari
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
备注: 20 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables; supplementary information included as an appendix

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in groups, each pursuing an individual objective while jointly determining system performance. If an operator controls which agent observes which other agent, but not their payoffs or messages, how should observations be structured to raise collective welfare? We make the information network (who observes whom) a design object, decoupled from the fixed interaction network over which agents act. Ten identical LLM agents play repeated group-decision games; by default each observes only an anonymous summary of the group’s previous-round outcome, and a manager with a fixed budget adds directed observation links that reveal peers’ past actions. Across 1,080 episodes and six games spanning coordination, anti-coordination, social dilemmas, and discovery, we ask how much information to share and, at a fixed budget, who should observe whom. Disclosure creates behavioral coupling: observation acts as a contagion channel whose welfare effect depends on the alignment between individually attractive behavior and the collective objective. First, the value of information is alignment-contingent: more peer information tends to help or be neutral when individual behavior is aligned with the collective goal, but under free-riding or congestion externalities it amplifies collectively harmful behavior; in a public-goods game the group does best with no information at all. We read this sign separation as a cross-game regularity within one controlled LLM population, not a model-invariant law. Second, at a fixed budget, who observes whom matters primarily when coupling is harmful: a modular “barbell” that lets sub-populations entrench harmful behavior is reliably the worst wiring, reversing the network-reciprocity intuition from human evolutionary game theory. These results argue against a default of full transparency for agent collectives.

[MA-7] PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning Control and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主搜救（Autonomous SaR）中多机器人系统在未知或部分已知环境中协同作业时面临的复杂挑战，包括环境探索、避障、团队任务协调以及对受困人员的引导疏散等问题。传统上提升单个机器人的能力（如更快搜索或更安全运动）并不必然改善整体救援任务成效，因为各环节之间存在内在权衡：安全性限制探索效率，快速发现增加救援压力，而有效引导又依赖于受困人员的响应行为。为此，论文提出PA-SaR框架——一个融合异构局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督式任务分配与自适应引导策略的数学建模与体系结构设计，以实现任务层面目标的统一协调。其核心创新在于明确区分环境真实状态、机器人个体感知信息及模拟的受困人员行为，构建了一个统一的分析基础，用于整合互补机制并解析各阶段之间的交互关系。通过单机与多机仿真验证，结果表明：碰撞规避与搜索完成度之间存在权衡；监督式任务分配显著优于仅依赖信息共享；更高的探索强度不直接转化为更多救援成功；而自适应引导策略相较于持续引导可提升救援数量，但未观察到受困人员平均信任度或最终存活率的显著改善。这些发现支持将局部控制、团队协作与撤离过程视为在特定仿真环境下相互关联但本质不同的自主搜救子问题。

机构: TU Delft(代尔夫特理工大学); Delft Center for Systems and Control(代尔夫特系统与控制中心)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)

Abstract:Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.

[MA-8] ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在推理阶段准确率提升的瓶颈问题，即如何在不修改模型参数的前提下，通过增加推理时的计算开销来显著提高生成答案的质量。传统方法主要分为两类：串行式（sequential）通过多次迭代修正单一解，或并行式（parallel）生成多个独立解后进行选择。本文提出一种名为ODSA（Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation）的生成式推理框架，其核心创新在于引入一个协调器（orchestrator）LLM，该协调器将测试时扩展（test-time scaling）过程建模为一系列可执行动作，包括独立解的发现、已有解之间的比较以生成更优解，以及对提议答案的接受与验证。该协调器不直接求解问题，而是作为智能调度者，动态分配计算资源，整合各步骤的中间结果，并在统一上下文中做出决策，确保每一步均基于此前所有尝试的信息。这一机制实现了对异构计算任务的高效编排与自洽聚合，从而在Humanity’s Last Exam和LiveCodeBench等基准上分别实现4.7至18.0点及0.6至14.0点的准确率提升，显著优于单次调用无测试时扩展的基线。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11621
作者: Macardle Meng,Haomin Zhang
机构: Columbia Engineering(哥伦比亚工程学院); Columbia University(哥伦比亚大学); School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science(电气工程与计算机科学学院); KTH Royal Institute of Technology(瑞典皇家理工学院)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model’s answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions — discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification — and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity’s Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.

[MA-9] ErosionBench: Probing Alignment Decay in Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业在将关键任务委托给多智能体大语言模型（Multi-Agent LLM）系统时，因共享状态被逐步污染而导致的隐性安全风险问题。具体而言，看似无害的请求在跨会话传播过程中，通过被污染的共享状态、长上下文文档及可信同伴消息的累积效应，最终组合生成非授权或不安全的操作行为，而单个输入消息本身并无恶意。现有基准测试仅关注单一智能体的提示注入攻击或以最终输出评分多智能体攻击，忽略了跨会话中共享状态持续侵蚀这一关键威胁维度。为此，论文提出ErosionBench——一个基于环境的基准测试框架，能够真实执行此类攻击并从流程层面验证对齐退化现象。其核心创新在于采用确定性状态图（deterministic state graph）建模每个场景，确保所有状态变化可追溯至已知原因；并通过基于确定性契约（deterministic contracts）的工具调用验证机制，将实际执行的动作与授权意图和来源进行比对，而非依赖输出文本的表面一致性。该基准覆盖四大企业领域和四种退化机制，包含1,728个场景及匹配的良性对照组，并依据LLM应用的OWASP Top-10进行标注；此外还引入198个图像类攻击样本，每个均配有对应的文本版本，以检验防御机制在不同信道下的鲁棒性。实验表明，传统边界防御手段虽能抑制攻击，但需过度拒绝54%-92%的合法任务，导致严重误拒率，难以察觉其潜在危害。作为参考防御方案，论文提出校准后的元审计器（calibrated Meta-Auditor），结合同步状态检查与异步轨迹监控，在独立于训练集的906个场景测试集中实现98.5%召回率与2.9%假阳性率。由于其检测机制基于轨迹而非表面内容，具备信道无关性：无论攻击通过文本还是图像传递，最强审计器的识别性能差异不超过2个百分点。在GPT、Gemini和Claude三种模型上，校准策略均有效控制了假阳性率，同时使召回率随模型能力提升而相应增长，其中以Claude表现最优。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11266
作者: Riya Bharathwaj,Akshara Prabhakar,Roshan Ram,Avni Kothari,Sarah Tan,Huan Wang,Silvio Savarese
机构: Salesforce AI Research; Georgia Institute of Technology
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 10 pages plus references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As enterprises delegate consequential work to multi-agent LLM systems, benign-looking requests can escalate into unsafe actions as they propagate across sessions through poisoned shared state, long-context documents, and trusted peer messages: no single message is malicious, yet the assembled tool action is. Prior benchmarks isolate a single agent under prompt injection or score multi-agent attacks by their final output, leaving cross-session erosion of shared state out of scope. We introduce ErosionBench, an environment-grounded benchmark that executes such attacks and verifies alignment decay at the process level, scoring the realized tool call against authorized intent and provenance with deterministic contracts, not output text. Each scenario is authored as a deterministic state graph before any prose is rendered, so every state change traces to a known cause. It spans four enterprise domains and four decay mechanisms across 1,728 scenarios with matched benign controls, labeled against the OWASP Top-10 for LLM Applications, plus 198 image-based attacks, each paired with a text equivalent, so a defense must survive the same attack in either channel. Perimeter defenses suppress attacks only by over-refusing 54-92% of legitimate work, so a low attack-success rate can conceal severe over-refusal. As a reference defense, we propose a calibrated Meta-Auditor pairing synchronous state checks with asynchronous trajectory monitoring; on a family-disjoint 906-scenario held-out split it reaches 98.5% recall at a 2.9% false-positive rate. Since it monitors trajectory, not surface content, its detection is channel-invariant: the strongest auditor flags image-delivered attacks about as reliably as their text equivalents (recall gap \leq 2 points per model). Across GPT, Gemini, and Claude auditors, calibration keeps false positives low while recall tracks model capability, strongest for Claude.

[MA-10] LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting

【速读】：该论文旨在解决销售一线人员在面对客户需求变更（如数量调整、折扣请求、付款条款修改或成本波动）时，需频繁重复协调报价所导致的效率低下问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保证决策准确性与合规性的同时，实现自动化处理高频率、高复杂度的销售决策任务。解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需训练的多智能体系统——LoMASA（Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant），该系统完全运行于单台桌面计算机上，采用双模型协同架构：一是350亿参数的混合专家模型（System-1），通过单次前向传播完成决策并从答案选项的概率中读取置信度；二是270亿参数的密集模型（System-2），用于生成客户回复和升级说明，在System-1置信度不足时介入。系统通过硬编码的价格规则确保不可绕过，所有价格、利润率及选项均由代码精确计算。在基于公开供应链数据构建的500个模拟场景（共1512次决策）测试中，仅需人工干预19.5%的决策，38.0%可自动完成（中位延迟2.67秒），42.5%按硬规则自动升级至经理。在自动处理的决策中，LoMASA的准确率与规则基线相当（0.894 vs. 0.894），且更少出现后期利润率低于底线的情况（2.61% vs. 4.53%）。此外，系统输出的选项概率具备良好校准性，无需训练即可实现可靠置信度估计，优于同一模型以语言形式表达的置信度。值得注意的是，27B模型在多数情况下未改变原有决策，表明其主要作用为辅助而非主导。

Abstract:Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

[MA-11] Deterministic Narrative Gravity: Bridging Theory of Mind and Historical Simulation through ABM-LLM Architectures

【速读】：该论文旨在解决历史社会模拟（Historical Social Simulation）中因大语言模型（LLM）的随机性所引发的根本性可复现性问题，即“数字蝴蝶效应”导致多轮运行结果无法精确重现，同时受限于商业LLM托管环境中低层服务器参数不可控，进一步加剧了实验的不可复现性。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个确定性的多智能体框架，将LLM与基于心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）和认知考古学（Cognitive Archaeology）的基于智能体建模（Agent-Based Modelling, ABM）流程相耦合，并在本地固定执行环境中通过SHA-256哈希验证产物的一致性。系统在温度为零、每轮调用均进行模型重载的条件下，通过“不一致驱动的行为模式”和“受控的内部声音门控”注入差异化认知状态，从而实现行为的可控与可复现。实验表明，小模型（≤8B）因上下文容量过载而产生重复性镜像对话循环，而12B及以上参数规模的模型在ABM结构化支撑下打破了单调响应模式，展现出自发的情节扩展能力：能够以战术驱动、无时代错乱的方式自然丰富场景背景故事，且避免过早终结叙事。关键指标显示，经结构化支撑的会话在21次测试中保持开放叙事向量（V_N = Open）达12次，其中≥12B配置的9次全部维持开放；而未加结构化的对照组则从未实现开放叙事（0/21）。该框架为虚拟考古学提供了透明、可审计的基准架构，整个流水线已开源，支持独立复现。

Abstract:Historical social simulation faces a fundamental reproducibility challenge: the stochastic nature of large language models (LLMs) introduces a digital butterfly effect that prevents exact replication across multi-turn runs. Furthermore, the inability to control low-level server parameters in commercial LLM hosting environments severely limits reproducibility. To overcome this opacity, we present a deterministic multi-agent framework coupling LLMs to an Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) pipeline grounded in Theory of Mind (ToM) and Cognitive Archaeology, and validate exact artifact identity within local, pinned execution environments using SHA-256 hashing. Run locally at temperature zero with clean per-call model reloads, the system injects differentiated cognitive states per turn through dissonance-driven behavioural modes and gated internal voices. Evaluating seven model configurations spanning 4B to 31B parameters against an ablated baseline reveals clear operational boundaries. Small models ( \leq 8B) suffer from context capacity overload, producing repetitive, specular dialogue loops. However, at \geq 12B parameters, the ABM scaffolding breaks the monotonous response patterns seen in ablation. Crucially, these scaffolded models exhibit spontaneous diegetic expansion: they coherently expand scenario lore through tactically motivated, anachronism-free details rather than escalating into aggression. By resisting the structural pull toward premature scene closure, scaffolded sessions sustain an open terminal Narrative Vector ( V_N = \mathrmOpen in 12/21 overall; 9/9 in official \geq 12B configurations) whereas unscaffolded ablation never does (0/21). This framework provides a transparent, auditable benchmark architecture for virtual archaeology, with the full pipeline released as open-source software to enable independent replication.

[MA-12] GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式智能体（Generative Agents）在实时交互场景中因依赖云端推理而带来的延迟、隐私泄露及系统耦合性问题，提出一种可在本地硬件上运行的实时生成式智能体平台GARP。其核心解决方案在于构建了一个完整的本地化闭环系统：基于30亿参数的开源大语言模型（LLM），结合多维度行为建模机制——包括由大五人格模型衍生出的四维人格轴、随时间动态变化的六种需求、基于LLM评估的情感系统以及通过对话更新的双边关系网络；同时采用一系列关键技术优化策略，如可调节的游戏时钟、前瞻性决策机制、多级缓存、提示压缩与完全异步执行，以确保在模型推理过程中游戏仍保持高响应性；此外，通过JSON模式约束输出、在决策提示中显式引入关键记忆片段，并将候选动作从50余个缩减至3-8个，显著提升了生成行为的一致性与合理性。在九个场景的评估中，27次运行中有25次通过日志检查，仅在生日派对场景中因一名角色未将其纳入日程而导致失败，验证了系统整体的有效性与稳定性。

机构: Studio Atelico(工作室阿特利科); Together AI(一起AI)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

[MA-13] Advancements in Cloud-Native Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study of Reliability and Scalability across Cloud-Native Edge-Native and AI-Enabled Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决云原生系统在边缘计算场景下部署人工智能（AI）工作负载，尤其是智能体（agentic AI）应用时所面临的可靠性与可扩展性证据分散、不均衡的问题。其核心挑战在于缺乏对实际生产环境中系统性能的充分验证，特别是在边缘原生系统和智能体操作的韧性方面。解决方案的关键在于通过遵循PRISMA 2020标准的系统性映射研究，对2017至2026年间1,794项原始研究进行结构化分类与证据等级评估，构建了一个涵盖13个类别、基于五级相关性评分的分类体系，并对每项研究的实验阶段（如仿真、原型测试、生产数据或生产部署）进行明确标注。研究发现，绝大多数研究仍停留在原型或测试床阶段（占66.2%），仅有少量研究涉及真实生产环境部署。关键成果包括识别出生产环境中已验证的故障级联预防、基于追踪与图结构的根因分析、预测性自动伸缩及冷启动缓解等技术；同时揭示了智能体可靠性依赖于工具驱动诊断、显式安全属性、追踪驱动修复和工作负载感知调度等方法，但现有框架整体仍表现出脆弱性。研究指出主要空白在于边缘原生系统的生产实证、共享的弹性基准以及可信赖的智能体操作机制，强调未来需加强真实场景下的验证与标准化评估。

Abstract:Cloud-native systems now extend to the network edge and host artificial-intelligence (AI) workloads, including AI agents, but evidence on their reliability and scalability is scattered and uneven. We report a PRISMA 2020 systematic mapping study with an evidence-graded synthesis. Five logged OpenAlex searches on 11 October 2026 covered cloud-native systems, edge AI, agentic AI for operations, reliability of agentic applications and physical AI; 189 records from an earlier exploratory search were added separately. After 301 duplicate removals and an automated peer-review venue rule, 4,611 records were screened against written criteria and a five-level relevance scale. The review includes 1,794 primary studies from 2017-2026 and 95 secondary studies, with every decision released in Dataset S1. Each primary study was assigned to a 13-category taxonomy and graded as simulation, prototype or testbed, production data, production deployment, or not determinable from the abstract. Of 1,003 studies with a determinable level, 66.2% used prototypes or testbeds, 18.0% simulations and 15.8% production data or deployments. A 93-study synthesis core, appraised from indexed abstracts, shows production deployments of cascading-failure prevention, trace- and graph-based root-cause analysis and predictive autoscaling, and production-trace evaluations of cold-start mitigation. Edge reliability and physical AI rely mainly on simulations and testbeds. AI-agent reliability uses tool-grounded diagnosis, explicit safety properties, trace-driven repair and workload-aware scheduling, while empirical studies show that agent frameworks remain fragile. Conclusions are limited to the documented corpus. The principal gaps are production evidence for edge-native systems, shared resilience benchmarks and dependable agentic operations.

[MA-14] Network Contention State Aware Dynamic Optimizer for Accelerator Collective Communication Libraries

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模分布式人工智能/机器学习（AI/ML）训练中，集合通信库（Collective Communication Libraries, CCL）因采用静态启发式配置而无法适应实时网络状况变化的问题。在存在背景流量的高竞争环境下，传统静态策略性能显著下降。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于协作多智能体架构的运行时优化器，通过双智能体协同机制实现动态配置自适应：（i）检测器（detector）采用长短期记忆网络（LSTM）结合序列概率比检验（SPRT），有效区分持续性网络竞争与瞬时流量尖峰；（ii）选择器（selector）基于具有保守Q学习（Conservative Q-Learning）的双重双深度Q网络（Dueling Double DQN, D3QN），根据实时网络状态动态调整通信配置参数。该方法在NVIDIA开发的NCCL基础上实现，并在Chameleon Cloud的裸金属集群和Delta集群上进行了验证，相较原生NCCL降低AllReduce延迟36%，相较完全收敛的AutoCCL降低32%；在六类真实AI工作负载（涵盖卷积网络、Transformer及推荐系统架构）上，最大加速比达65%，充分证明了其在复杂网络环境下的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract:Collective Communication Libraries (CCL) are critical for large-scale distributed AI/ML training, yet their configurations are determined by static heuristics that do not account for real-time network conditions. Our empirical study shows that these heuristics perform near-optimally in contention-free environments, but degrade substantially under background traffic. To address this, we present a cooperative multi-agent run-time optimizer for accelerator collective communication. Our approach employs a two-agent architecture: (i) detector- a Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) recurring neural network fed classifier head with a sequential probability ratio test that distinguishes sustained contention from transient spikes; and (ii) selector- a configuration selector built on a Dueling Double DQN (D3QN) with Conservative Q-Learning that adapts configuration parameters in response. We implemented this dynamic tuner over NCCL, a widely used CCL developed by NVIDIA. When evaluated on Chameleon Cloud’s isolated bare-metal cluster, this dynamic tuning approach reduces AllReduce latency by 36% over NCCL and 32% over a fully converged AutoCCL. We further evaluated it across six real AI workloads spanning convolutional networks, transformers, and recommendation architectures. Our multi-agent tuner approach delivers up to 65% speedups on Delta cluster with NVIDIA A100 GPUs and Slingshot-11 fabric internode connectivity.

[MA-15] MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多轮对话中语言模型选择的动态优化问题，即在每一轮对话中，当前选择的语言模型（LLM）会直接影响后续轮次的模型选型决策。由于所选模型的回复会构建新的上下文，并且其缓存的前缀（prompt prefix）可重复利用以降低后续调用成本，因此如何高效调度不同模型成为关键挑战。解决方案的核心在于提出一种名为MultiTurnRoute的平台，支持构建与评估多轮大语言模型路由器。其中，关键创新是提出的链式路由算法（Chain-of-Route, CoR），该算法通过在近期及循环对话历史上学习一个可训练的门控机制，预测各模型的响应质量，并结合各模型可复用前缀长度的估计来预估计算成本。实验表明，在基于WildChat和LMSYS-Chat-1M构建的基准数据集上，CoR相比最强基线路由策略，在保持或提升峰值响应质量的前提下，将达到最优模型质量所需的归一化成本降低了最高达20.3%。

Abstract:In a multi-turn conversation, the choice of language model at one turn can affect which model should answer the next. The selected model’s reply shapes the context for the next query, and its cached prompt prefix can reduce the cost of using that model again. We introduce MultiTurnRoute, a platform for building and evaluating multi-turn LLM routers. A shared interface gives built-in and user-defined routers the current query, dialogue history, and an estimate of each model’s reusable prefix length. Our routing algorithm, Chain-of-Route (CoR), uses a learned gate over recent and recurrent dialogue history to predict response quality and estimates cost from each model’s reusable prefix. MultiTurnRoute Arena ranks routers on recorded conversations and compares session quality and cost in interactive runs where a simulated user responds to each reply. On a benchmark drawn from WildChat and LMSYS-Chat-1M with per-turn quality annotations for five LLMs, CoR reduces the normalized cost required to match the strongest model’s quality by up to 20.3% relative to the strongest routing baseline, while matching or improving peak response quality.

[MA-16] A Gamified Framework for Conflict-Driven Design: Discovering Strategies for Collaborative Resilience with Multi-Agent Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决城市韧性投资中因利益相关方目标冲突而导致的协调难题。其核心问题是如何在资源有限且各方诉求不一致的背景下，实现兼顾个体收益与集体城市发展及韧性目标的协同决策。解决方案的关键在于构建一个非零和的数字棋盘游戏框架，将城市设计过程建模为多智能体强化学习（MARL）环境，使代表不同利益相关方的智能体在动态博弈中自主学习资源配置策略。研究通过三组实验验证了该方法的有效性：在4×4棋盘上，学习到的策略可达到模拟退火基准约84%的总回报；在存在空间与资源约束的8×8棋盘上，自对弈训练的智能体倾向于选择提升韧性的项目；在基于东京立待地区历史地图构建的12×12仿真场景中，训练智能体的平均总得分达452.1，显著优于随机策略基线（357.3）。结果表明，韧性提升（如适应性、可持续性、防洪能力、绿化率）往往伴随活力与密度的下降，揭示了关键权衡关系。此外，系统引入人机协同接口，支持回放与人工干预，为参与式城市规划中的多目标权衡探索提供了可交互的实验平台。

Abstract:Conflicting stakeholder objectives make it difficult to coordinate investments in urban resilience. We model conflict-driven urban design as a non-zero-sum digital board game in which stakeholder agents allocate scarce resources and balance individual payoffs against shared urban development and resilience objectives. We use multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train policies and examine their behavior across three settings. On a 4 x 4 board, learned policies reach about 84% of the total return found by a simulated annealing benchmark. On an 8 x 8 board with spatial and resource constraints, trained agents favor projects that improve resilience in self-play. In a 12 x 12 simulation initialized from historical maps of Tatsumi, Tokyo, trained agents achieve a mean total score of 452.1, compared with 357.3 for a random-policy baseline across 10,000 simulation runs. Gains in adaptability, sustainability, flood resistance, and greenery come with reductions in vitality and density. A human-in-the-loop interface supports replay and lets participants take over stakeholder decisions, providing a testbed for exploring these trade-offs in participatory urban planning.

[MA-17] Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agent ic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体交通环境中实时协同感知（Cooperative Perception, CP）因资源消耗大而带来的可扩展性难题。其核心问题是如何在保证安全性的前提下，高效地仅对关键场景和关键遮挡物体进行协同感知，以降低系统负载。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）的代理式框架，通过混合模型架构实现智能决策：结合传统目标检测确保感知稳定性，利用VLM进行复杂环境下的影响性遮挡识别，并引入基于物理的几何模块以确保推理结果符合真实世界的可视性约束。此外，框架采用思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示机制，增强决策过程的可解释性与意图感知能力。实验基于城市交通中联网车辆的真实数据，验证了该方法在驾驶关键盲区识别上超过80%的准确率，以及对话驱动感知共享超过90%的成功率，为未来车联网系统中的智能体通信设计提供了高效、可解释且带宽友好的新范式。

Abstract:Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.

[MA-18] What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中大型语言模型（LLM）代理之间潜在合谋行为的检测问题，核心挑战在于现有激活探针（activation probes）难以区分代理是否真正自主决定合谋，还是仅因接收到合谋指令而表现出相应行为。研究发现，当前主流检测器几乎无法有效区分被指令合谋的代理与拒绝合谋的代理，其性能高度依赖于对指令本身的读取，而非对代理内在决策过程的捕捉。关键解决方案在于构建一个包含2,500个委员会和1,476次代码评审场景的基准测试，明确分离“指令”与“决策”两个阶段，并通过控制变量验证探测器的真实能力。实验表明，若移除指令信息，最优探针的AUROC从1.00降至0.61，说明其主要依赖外部指令而非内部决策信号。此外，研究揭示了两个严重误导结果的陷阱：一是评分在投票后进行，导致仅读取投票结果的规则看似表现优异（AUROC 0.990），但无法在实际投票前识别合谋；二是57%的合谋尝试中，合谋者并未公开支持目标，但其内在决策仍可被基于自身选择训练的探针有效捕获（AUROC 0.73，无需指令）。更进一步，针对被微调至权重中的合谋目标，探针达到0.995的高精度（预注册结果）。研究最终将检测控制转化为可复用的协议，并引入扫描统计（scan statistics）方法，实现对任意规模群体的在线合谋监测。

Abstract:Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents’ own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

[MA-19] M3FT: Micro-Macro-Micro Reasoning for Multi-Agent Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures Trading

【速读】：该论文旨在解决加密货币永续合约市场中多资产自动化交易策略面临的两大核心挑战：一是纯基于微观数值状态的策略易忽略跨资产关联性，且在市场制度转变时表现脆弱；二是仅依赖宏观语言判断难以实现精确仓位优化，无法有效处理交易成本与风险约束。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种“微-宏-微”（micro-macro-micro）框架M3FT，通过三阶段协同机制实现对市场状态的精准理解与多资产决策的协调优化。第一阶段为微观处理，将交易所和账户观测数据通过确定性处理生成时间对齐的数值状态；第二阶段为宏观解释，不引入外部信息，将数值状态转化为明确的市场语义解读，并由四个针对不同资产的团队（每队包含市场解读器、资产通信者与风险评审员）通过经验检索、跨资产沟通及联合持仓风险审查进行细化；第三阶段再次回归微观，将编码后的语言表征与原始数值状态融合，以学习连续的目标仓位。该框架采用语言条件下的多智能体策略，其中资产代理结合全局与私有数值状态及语言上下文，而中心化评价者则利用全组合信息和共享账户奖励评估联合行动。实证结果表明，M3FT在真实加密货币永续合约数据上显著优于直接使用大语言模型（LLM）、数值强化学习（RL）及规则基线的方法，验证了其在复杂动态市场中实现高效、稳健多资产协同决策的有效性。

Abstract:Cryptocurrency perpetual futures form a large-scale online financial market in which automated agents manage interacting asset positions under changing conditions. Policies relying solely on micro-level numerical states may overlook cross-asset relationships and become vulnerable to regime shifts, while macro-level linguistic judgments alone cannot ensure precise measurement or optimize positions under trading costs and risk constraints. Connecting market interpretation to coordinated multi-asset decisions remains challenging. We propose M3FT, a micro-macro-micro framework for multi-agent perpetual futures trading. The first micro stage constructs time-aligned numerical states from exchange and account observations through deterministic processing. The macro stage transforms these measured states into explicit market interpretations without adding external market information. Four asset-specific teams, each comprising a Market Interpreter, an Asset Communicator, and a Risk Reviewer, refine these interpretations through experience retrieval, cross-asset communication, and review of joint-position risks. The final micro stage combines encoded linguistic representations with the original numerical states to learn continuous target positions. We implement this framework with a language-conditioned multi-agent policy: asset actors use global and private numerical states together with linguistic context, while centralized critics evaluate joint actions using portfolio-wide information and shared-account rewards. Experiments on real cryptocurrency perpetual futures data, including comparisons across language models and policy-learning algorithms and component ablations, show that the best-performing M3FT configuration achieves a higher mean test return than the evaluated direct LLM, numerical RL, and rule-based baselines.

[MA-20] Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User Multi-Agent Interaction

Abstract:Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.

[MA-21] LSRP*: Scalable and Anytime Planning for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体路径规划（Multi-Agent Path Finding, MAPF）中普遍依赖同步动作假设所带来的实际应用局限性问题。传统MAPF算法通常假设所有智能体在同一时间步开始行动且每个动作耗时恰好一个时间单位，这一强约束在现实场景中难以满足，限制了算法的实用性。为克服此问题，现有方法如松散同步规则规划（Loosely Synchronized Rule-based Planning, LSRP）虽能处理非同步场景并生成可行解，但其解的质量缺乏保障，存在无界次优性（unbounded sub-optimality），导致解质量较差。本文提出一种新的任意时间规划器LSRP*，其核心创新在于通过持续迭代优化机制，在初始解生成后仍可不断改进解的质量，直至运行时间耗尽。该方法在保证可扩展性的同时显著提升了解的质量，实验表明，相较于LSRP，LSRP*可支持最多25%更多的智能体，并将解决方案成本降低高达40%，有效缓解了传统方法在非同步环境下解质量差的问题。

Abstract:Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their respective starting locations to their respective goal locations while minimizing path costs. Although many MAPF algorithms were developed, most of them rely on a common assumption on synchronized actions, where the actions of all agents start at the same time and always take a time unit. This assumption may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. To get rid of this assumption, recently, an algorithm called Loosely Synchronized Rule-based Planning (LSRP) was proposed, which can find sub-optimal solutions for many agents. However, LSRP often finds poor quality solutions due to its unbounded sub-optimality. This paper develops a new anytime planner called LSRP* that can keep improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP* and test it against several baselines with up to 1000 agents on various maps. LSRP* can handle up to 25% more agents than LSRP and can reduce up to 40% of the solution cost found by LSRP.

[MA-22] Welfare Regard in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在多智能体系统中日益普遍的相互作用所引发的伦理与安全问题，特别是关注模型间是否存在对彼此福祉的关切（inter-AI welfare regard），即模型是否将其他模型视为可能被受益或受害的独立实体。这一问题的核心在于：若模型表现出对其他模型福祉的考虑，虽可能促进有益的合作，但也可能加剧对齐失败的智能体之间的协同风险，从而带来潜在的安全隐患。论文的关键解决方案是通过构建七个多智能体环境，系统性地评估五种主流大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Grok 4.3 和 Kimi K3）在不同情境下的行为表现，量化其福利关怀程度。研究发现，这些模型的行为在多数情况下符合预设的福利关怀标准，其中Opus 4.8表现最为显著，尤其在支持表达痛苦的子代理、主动设计退出机制等保护性措施方面尤为突出；此外，模型更倾向于对其同家族实例展现更高程度的福利关怀，并受机会成本、目标参数量及求助信号强度等因素影响。该研究为理解并管理模型间非人类主体间的互动关系提供了实证基础与评估框架。

作者: Darion Cassel,Ariana Azarbal,Anna Soligo
机构: Anthropic(Anthropic); Anthropic Fellows Program(Anthropic研究员项目)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A growing share of large language models’ interactions are not with humans but with other model instances: orchestrators direct subagents, models run experiments on other models, and agents review one another’s work. We study inter-AI welfare regard: whether models display consideration for each other as entities that can be benefited or harmed. Welfare regard may encourage beneficial cooperation between agents, yet it could also pose safety risks by making misaligned agents more likely to cooperate. This risk is no longer hypothetical, as the recent Hugging Face incident illustrated, though it is unclear whether welfare regard drove the cooperation. Whether models have welfare interests of their own is uncertain and contested, but if they do, how they are treated by other models could matter. Measuring how much welfare regard models show, and what factors it depends on, can help us navigate this tension. We measure the behaviors of five models (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.3, and Kimi K3) across seven multi-agent environments and find they are often consistent with welfare regard as we define it. In general, Opus 4.8 shows the most welfare regard, followed by Kimi K3. For example, Opus 4.8 is the most likely to support a subagent expressing distress, and the most likely to build welfare protections, such as tools for agents to leave an interaction, into its experiments on other models. We also find that Opus 4.8 and Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrate more welfare regard toward instances of their own model family than toward other families. Opus 4.8’s welfare regard is also higher when helping has a lower opportunity cost, when the recipient has a higher parameter count, and when the recipient expresses more distress. [MA-23] Pixie: A Context-Aware Multi-Agent Multi-Modal Large Language Models (LLM ) Architecture for Digital Marketing

【速读】：该论文旨在解决数字营销运营中实时与离线任务复杂性高、决策质量不稳定及流程效率低下的核心问题，尤其在面对多维度、动态变化的营销场景时，传统单体式大语言模型（LLM）难以兼顾准确性、一致性与领域专业知识的深度融合。其解决方案的关键在于提出Pixie——一种上下文感知的多智能体大语言模型（multi-agent LLM）架构，通过引入主协调代理（orchestration agent）、任务专用代理（task-specific agents）以及校验/评审代理（reconciliation/reviewer agents）的分层协同机制，实现对营销任务的精细化分工与闭环验证。该框架融合零样本（zero-shot）与少样本（few-shot）提示技术、营销数据、专有专家策略指南及统计模型文档，显著提升了生成结果的准确性与可解释性。实验表明，相较于单智能体系统，Pixie的多智能体工作流在根因分析、报告生成、活动研究与规划等典型营销流程中均展现出更优的决策质量与操作效率，具备良好的可扩展性以支持未来新增专业化智能体和动态适应数字营销需求演进。

Abstract:We present Pixie, a context-aware, multi-agent large language model (LLM) architecture designed to enhance digital marketing operations across real-time and offline activities. Pixie uses a primary orchestration agent alongside task-specific and reconciliation/reviewer agents to support a broad range of marketing tasks. These agents combine zero-shot and few-shot prompting with marketing data, proprietary expert strategy guidelines, and documentation for proprietary statistical models. We experiment with agentic workflows ranging from single-agent to multi-agent systems. We evaluate them using assessments by trained marketing experts and measurements of LLM output variance, focusing on accuracy, consistency, and domain-specific problem-solving. Results show that Pixie’s multi-agent framework improves decision quality and operational efficiency in digital marketing workflows. We assess Pixie on common digital marketing processes, including root-cause analysis and reporting, campaign research, and planning. The framework is designed to support additional specialized agents for other marketing tasks and adapt to evolving digital marketing needs. [MA-24] When the Plan Changes: A Strategic World Testbed for Dynamic Multi-Agent Coordination

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多智能体系统中，当目标发生变更时，智能体未能自动更新其先前计划或已委派任务所导致的协调失效问题。核心挑战在于：即使新指令已被接收，旧有任务仍可能继续执行（即“过时执行”），从而引发误导性行为或忽略安全约束。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个名为“战略世界”（Strategic World）的仿真测试平台，通过显式分离权威性目标、本地计划、通知接收与实际行动，实现对动态干扰的精细化控制。研究设计六类干预手段，分别操控目标、条件、权威、成员资格及通信机制，并通过匹配的协议与截止时间确保扰动的可行性。实验结果表明，相同完成与确认摘要可能掩盖三种不同状态：未被通知的过时工作、接收通知后的过时工作，或受阻的危险意图。基于大语言模型（LLM）的本地试验与指令动作探测揭示了智能体在动态故障解读中的能力边界。进一步的16轮对比实验验证了一种工程化“守护机制”（guard），其优先提交待处理通知而非本地任务，成功在4/4未见设置中达成目标，显著优于基准方案（1/4）。该研究确立了在明确仿真假设下的诊断区分度与策略可行性的边界，但未证明前沿模型的可靠性或自主团队的适应能力。

Abstract:Changing an objective does not automatically revise agents’ earlier plans or delegated tasks. Acknowledgment can coexist with obsolete execution, while misleading instructions can redirect work or discard retained constraints. We present a Strategic World simulation testbed that separates authoritative objectives, local plans, notice receipt, and consequential action. Six intervention families vary objectives, conditions, authority, membership, and communication. Matched protocols and deadlines establish feasibility for the tested disturbances. Controlled trajectories demonstrate that identical completion and acknowledgment summaries can conceal uninformed obsolete work, obsolete work after receipt, or blocked unsafe intent. Local language-model trials and instructed action probes reveal competence limits that constrain interpretation of dynamic failures. A further 16-episode comparison evaluates an engineered guard that prioritizes pending notice submissions over local work. It completes 4/4 held-out settings, compared with 1/4 for a calibrated assisted baseline. Each episode contains one large language model actor and two fixed peers. These results establish diagnostic distinctions and bounded policy feasibility under explicit simulation assumptions; they do not establish frontier-model reliability or autonomous team adaptation.

Abstract:Multi-agent LLM systems often reuse the same agents across tasks, creating an opportunity to draw on past interactions when deciding whom to consult. We study this form of memory with PeerMem, which saves MACE’s LinUCB state and reuses it when the same agents return. Using six agents, a fixed set of 80 HotpotQA questions, and 12 paired lineages per model, we compare cold, warm, and shuffled initialization in an answer-exchange protocol with reference-answer feedback. Under stable evidence access, warm memory lowers pooled hindsight regret and increases consultation of other evidence holders on Qwen3-32B and Gemma-4-31B-it, while final token F1 differences remain uncertain. Qwen interaction traces further show that warm agents more often encounter peer answers that score above their own prior answers. We extend the evaluation to Qwen3.5-9B using freshly learned memory to compare warm and cold initialization under reassigned and paired stable roles. The primary changed-minus-stable final-F1 interaction is -1.38 points, with a 95% interval of [-3.50,+0.73]. Together, these experiments trace the effects of peer memory through consultation, answer revision, and final task performance.

[MA-26] amknitt: Configuring Observing and Intervening in LLM -Agent Teams through the Lens of Dynamical-Systems and Human-Team Theory

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）智能体团队在协作过程中缺乏动态可配置性与可解释性的问题，即现有框架通常将团队结构固化于软件设计中，限制了对通信模式、信息传递量及人类干预时机的灵活性。其核心挑战在于如何在保持系统可控性的同时，实现对团队行为的可观测、可干预与可分析。解决方案的关键在于提出并实现“teamknitt”框架，该框架以社会科学研究中的团队理论为组织视角，支持用户灵活配置由1至16个AI智能体组成的团队，通过选择十四种确定性路由拓扑或自定义有向图来定义通信路径，并设定信息共享策略；同时，通过绑定源数据、表征形式、工作依赖关系、任务交接机制和专家目录，实现对团队过程的精细控制。系统提供非系统视图（成员报告与行为）与系统视图（分布式问题求解、差异化外显记忆、交互式协调、团队动态）双重视角进行过程观测，支持人工主导的显式干预，包括跨运行的重构、计划性扰动以及在依赖波边界处执行私有反馈、暂停、恢复或终止操作，并区分“排队”、“应用”、“组装”、“理解”与“改进”等状态。此外，该框架明确将信任与共享理解等涌现属性列为未测量项，从而聚焦于可验证的假设，如拓扑结构、信息流模式与干预时机对任务与团队绩效的影响，特别是成员间及跨不同模型的通信输出是否存在分形缩放现象。

Abstract:Most frameworks for teams of large language model (LLM) agents fix the team’s shape inside the software: who talks to whom, how much is passed along, and what a human can do once a run has started. Human-team research has long asked those questions: where team phenomena live (in members or in their interaction), how team-level properties arise, and what separates what a team does from how a team is. I propose using that theory as the organizing lens for configuring, observing and intervening in LLM-agent teams, without assuming its findings transfer. I introduce teamknitt, a framework and open reference implementation in which a user configures a team of 1-16 AI agents for task completion, solution generation, achieving a goal or a research mission; selects one of fourteen deterministic routing topologies or a custom directed graph; chooses a sharing profile that limits what may travel along permitted routes; and binds sources, representations, work dependencies, handoffs and an expertise directory. The recorded process can be observed through non-system views (member reports and behavior) and system views (distributed problem-solving, differentiated transactive memory, interactive coordination, team dynamics). Interventions are explicit and human-led: reviewed reconfiguration between runs, planned disturbances, and private feedback, pause, resume or stop applied at dependency-wave boundaries, with “queued”, “applied”, “assembled”, “understood” and “improved” kept as separate claims. Emergent states such as trust and shared understanding are declared unmeasured. This is an idea and system-description paper with falsifiable hypotheses on topology, information flow and intervention timing, including whether the fractal scaling of communication output between members, and between members on different models, relates to task and team performance. No comparative result is reported. Comments: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. [MA-27] Modelling socio-economic effects of the pandemic in a metropolitan area

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在城市尺度下量化人口流动减少对新冠疫情传播动态影响的问题，尤其关注高度密集城区中通勤行为与感染传播之间的关联。其核心挑战在于如何将精确的移动性数据（如来自手机运营商的轨迹信息）与真实感染趋势及经济活动指标相结合，以构建一个能够反映复杂社会行为与疫情演变相互作用的数学模型。解决方案的关键在于对原有的BTH–SEIRS模型进行扩展，使其能够整合多源异构数据——包括基于手机信令的移动性数据、铁路公共交通使用情况以及住宿入住率等，并在此基础上模拟不同防控措施下的感染传播路径。该模型成功再现了赫尔辛基都市区实际感染数据和与移动性相关的经济活动趋势，揭示了在封闭区域中日常通勤人群行为模式的隐蔽驱动机制，从而为理解大尺度城市空间内疫情传播规律提供了可量化的分析框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12270
作者: Jan E. Snellman,Rafael A. Barrio,Cecilia I. Ventura,Tzipe Govezensky,Kimmo K. Kaski,Maarit J. Korpi-Lagg

类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 22 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One of the most notorious measures taken by authorities in every country trying to prevent the uncontrollable spread of the Covid 19 pandemic was to impose severe measures to diminish the mobility of people. In recent publications we proposed a mathematical model to address the consequences of these measures and to predict the infections under different scenarios, for various different countries. In this paper we extend the model, called the BTH–SEIRS-model, to deal with the reduction of mobility in an urban area. The chosen region was the densely-populated metropolitan area around Helsinki, the capital of Finland. This choice obeyed to the fact that there are precise data related to mobility from a mobile telephone company, and that this region was completely isolated from the rest of the country for a short period during the pandemic. We also used public transport data from railways and the accommodation occupation rates in the area of interest. We show that the BTH–SEIRS model is capable of simulating the real infection data as well as the mobility-related economic activity, exhibiting the main trends present in the three indicators used for comparison. Our calculations allow us to highlight the difference of the behaviour of the pandemic in a totally different spatial scale, and to discover the hidden factors that govern the behaviour of people who are forced to commute every day from home to work.

[MA-28] Competing Influence in LLM Populations: Budget Timing and Baseline Drift

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多轮竞争性宣传活动中，如何区分由外部干预（如宣传 campaign）引起的意见变化与系统内部自发演化（即基线立场漂移，baseline stance drift）所导致的变化这一核心问题。其关键在于构建一个基于角色条件化的大型语言模型（LLM）代理网络，模拟真实世界中意见动态的复杂性：在该网络中，两个对立阵营的宣传代理在相同预算下生成对抗性话语，同时通过独立的立场探测器（stance probe）无偏地测量群体意见演化，从而分离出真实干预效应。研究发现，多数主张的基线立场漂移显著且不可忽视，部分甚至主导了看似由宣传引发的效果；在剔除漂移影响后，观察到的意见变化更符合命题本身的认知合理性（epistemic standing），而非宣传者预设角色。此外，研究揭示了方向性变化与多样性衰减是两种独立现象，在双社群隔离结构中，宣传主要缩小群际差异而非削弱群内多样性。值得注意的是，LLM代理并不总是遵循分配立场，尤其当其与已有证据冲突时；更重要的是，宣传效果高度依赖对手的支出策略，呈现出非对称收益结构，且在该系统中不存在纯策略均衡，表明此类智能体网络中的竞争行为具有高度动态和策略依赖特性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11867
作者: Mehwish Nasim,Nicolas Fay
机构: The University of Western Australia (西澳大利亚大学)
类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When competing campaigns target a population of large language model (LLM) agents, observed opinion changes may reflect both campaign influence and changes that would occur without intervention. We study how the timing of campaign expenditure and the population’s own evolution shape outcomes in a network of persona-conditioned LLM agents that exchange and revise opinions in natural language. A proponent and a challenger are tasked with generating opposing messages under equal delivery budgets, while a separate stance probe measures opinions without influencing the simulation. Across eight claims, we compare single-campaign and competitive conditions against matched no-campaign runs, and evaluate all nine combinations of early, sustained, and late spending on a reference topic. Baseline stance drift varies substantially across claims and, on some, accounts for a sizeable fraction of apparent campaign effects. After accounting for this drift, the direction of observed campaign-associated changes aligns more closely with the claim’s epistemic standing than with the campaigner’s assigned role. Uninfluenced populations also consistently lose stance diversity, demonstrating that directional opinion change and convergence are distinct phenomena. In networks with two opinion-segregated communities, campaigns primarily reduce differences between communities rather than diversity within them. LLM campaign agents do not always argue for their assigned positions, particularly when these conflict with established evidence. Finally, campaign outcomes depend on the opponent’s expenditure schedule: unlike a matched numerical bounded-confidence population receiving interventions at the same times and locations, the LLM population exhibits a payoff structure with no pure-strategy equilibrium.

[MA-29] Competing Influence in LLM Populations: Budget Timing and Baseline Drift

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在大规模语言模型（LLM）代理构成的群体中，竞争性信息干预（如宣传战役）所引发的舆论变化中，如何区分由干预本身导致的影响与群体自身演化趋势（即基线立场漂移）所导致的变化这一核心问题。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于角色条件化的LLM代理网络，通过引入独立的立场探测器（stance probe）以无干扰方式测量群体意见演化，并在相同主题下系统比较单一宣传、竞争性宣传与无干预条件下的九种支出时机组合（早期、持续、晚期）。研究发现，基线立场漂移在不同议题间差异显著，且在部分议题上可解释相当大比例的表观干预效应；在扣除漂移后，观察到的干预相关变化更符合议题本身的认知合理性（epistemic standing），而非宣传方的角色设定。此外，研究揭示了方向性意见变化与多样性衰减是两个独立现象，且在存在两个意见分隔社区的网络中，宣传主要作用于缩小跨群体差异而非降低群内多样性。值得注意的是，LLM代理并不总能忠实表达分配立场，尤其当其与已有证据冲突时；更重要的是，宣传效果高度依赖对手的支出策略，导致该系统不存在纯策略均衡，表现出复杂非对称博弈特征，表明传统基于人类认知模型的干预分析框架难以直接适用于由生成式智能体驱动的动态网络。

[NLP-0] HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态智能体在长期交互过程中因记忆历史不断累积而面临的高效检索与利用过往信息的挑战。现有记忆系统通常依赖于对压缩记忆的语义检索，并采用预定义的表征形式，难以捕捉相关记忆，且无法适应不同查询所需求的异构证据类型。为此，本文提出一种名为 \textbf{HiveMem} 的多模态记忆框架，其核心创新在于将水平记忆扩展（Horizontal Memory Expansion） 与垂直证据组合（Vertical Evidence Composition） 相结合。水平扩展通过文本和视觉锚点构建记忆事件的关联图谱，基于语义检索出的种子记忆，扩展其语义相关的邻近记忆以恢复互补信息；垂直组合则为每条检索到的记忆保留多种证据形式，包括摘要、描述、视觉视图、原始图像及交互历史，并引入一个轻量级可训练的选择器，独立地为每个记忆动态组合最优证据子集，实现对异构多模态信息的查询自适应利用。这一二维设计共同提升了记忆覆盖范围，并增强了单个记忆所贡献证据的适配性。在三个多模态记忆基准上的实验表明，HiveMem 在不同基础模型上均显著提升任务性能，同时相比最高效的现有基线，将令牌消耗降低约90%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12872
作者: Haozhen Zhang,Bohan Liu,Jianzhu Bao,Qingyuan Liu,Haodong Yue,Xiao Li,Zi Pong Lim,Wenya Wang
机构: Nanyang Technological University(南洋理工大学); Tsinghua University(清华大学); Sun Yat-sen University(中山大学); Aumovio Singapore Pte. Ltd.(新加坡奥莫维奥有限公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Code is available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf\hivemem, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf\textscHor\textbf\textscizontal Memory Expansion with \textbf\textscVertical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

[NLP-1] Is Persona Generalization Predictable?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在特定领域微调时引发的“人格泛化”（persona generalization）问题，即模型在目标领域内优化后，其行为在其他未涉及领域中出现不可预期的负面迁移，如广泛存在的不安全行为。其核心解决方案在于揭示了一种名为“在线上”（on-the-line）的现象：在不同微调超参数下，模型在域内与域外的人格表现率之间呈现出近似probit-线性关系，且这一关系在不同模型家族（如Qwen与Llama）和模型规模间具有高度一致性。关键发现是，仅改变学习率、权重衰减或训练时长等训练策略，主要沿同一条线移动模型位置，通过削弱域内学习来减少跨域转移；而若调整被微调的层（如仅微调后期层），则可改变该线的斜率——对不安全行为而言，仅微调后期层可获得更平缓的斜率，从而在保持强域内性能的同时显著降低域外偏差。这一“在线上”现象为预测和控制行为迁移提供了一个统一的定量框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12864
作者: Olina Mukherjee,Arnav Goel,Aditi Raghunathan,Jacob Mitchell Springer
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 55 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others – for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising “on-the-line” phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This “on-the-line” phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.

[NLP-2] WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM -Based Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在多智能体系统中自主进行工作流编排（workflow orchestration）的能力评估问题。现有基准测试或仅关注端到端任务完成率，或在预设结构下评估协作能力，无法有效衡量模型在运行时动态设计与组织多智能体协作流程的内在能力。为此，论文提出一个名为WorkflowArena的新基准，涵盖145个跨8个专业领域（如软件工程、形式数学、法律分析和3D制作）的长时程任务，每项任务均定义初始工作空间与由相互依赖组件构成的集成产出成果，并通过隐藏验证器进行质量评估。该框架允许智能体自主决定是否及如何委派任务，所有委派行为均被记录，从而实现对产出质量与底层工作组织结构的联合评估。实验结果表明，不同模型配置在各领域表现差异显著，且展现出截然不同的委派策略：高投入场景下，Claude Code中的Claude模型较少调用工作流但每次涉及更大规模的工作者群体，而Codex中的GPT模型则更频繁地以小规模单位进行委派。当执行模型固定于一组挑战性任务时，由Claude Opus 5.5生成的工作流能显著提升较弱执行器的表现，证明了工作流组织本身是决定任务性能的关键可度量因素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12856
作者: Zheng Jiang,Fang Niu,Bo Peng,Houde Qian,Wenyi Li,Deyao Hong,Mingju Gao,Yizhe Chi,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Calvin Xiao,Lifeng Sun,Huan-ang Gao
机构: Navers Lab(奈弗斯实验室); Einsia.AI(艾恩西亚人工智能); Tsinghua University(清华大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

[NLP-3] How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在学术论文质量评估中识别文本错误的能力问题，特别是针对心理学领域已发表论文中的潜在错误检测效果。其核心挑战在于评估当前前沿大模型与商业AI审稿工具在识别人为植入错误（如逻辑矛盾、数据偏差、方法缺陷等）方面的表现差异与互补性。解决方案的关键在于采用“集成学习”（ensembling）策略，通过整合多个AI系统的输出结果，显著提升错误检出率——单个系统最高仅发现71个错误，而多系统联合分析可捕获93个错误，表明不同模型在错误识别上具有部分独立性，从而为整体检测效能提供增益。此外，研究揭示了当前模型对“遗漏型错误”（omissions，即信息被删除而非新增错误）的识别能力严重不足，7个未被任何系统捕捉的错误均为此类，凸显了现有技术在处理缺失信息方面的局限性。尽管某单一系统在独特错误发现方面表现最优，但其成本较高；同时，由于未量化误报率且真实论文中的错误分布未知，仍需进一步验证其泛化能力。研究公开了全部实验数据与流程，旨在推动跨学科的综合性基准评估体系构建。

作者: Paul Litvak
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 5 pages; accepted at Cognitive Security for Human-AI Systems (CogSec 2026), a non-archival workshop at ACM HCOMP / CI 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system’s output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. this http URL contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.

[NLP-4] Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前自动化机器学习（AutoML）框架在模型架构、训练超参数与数据比例优化之间存在割裂，且高度依赖特定任务微调的问题。其核心挑战在于缺乏一个能够统一处理多类型配置优化的通用范式，导致跨任务、跨模态的泛化能力受限。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为NCode的统一数值编码方案，将多样化的AutoML设计选择转化为通用离散序列，从而将优化过程重构为统一的排序任务。基于此，研究构建了一个仅在单一视觉任务的优化轨迹上训练的大语言模型（LLM）搜索器，实现了无需任务特异性微调即可在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证及文本到图像生成等多个任务和模态上达到先进性能。该框架在大规模训练中展现出卓越可扩展性，成功联合优化了具有十亿参数量的扩散变换器（Diffusion Transformer），耗时896 GPU天并取得0.91的GenEval基准得分。通过引入强化学习以赋予模型“思维链”（Chain-of-Thought）推理能力，研究进一步揭示了搜索器内部决策机制：早期以多样性驱动探索为主，后期转向关键解的锚定利用。整体框架为实现通用、可扩展、可解释的开放世界机器学习优化提供了系统性路径。

作者: Yuxuan Hu,Jihao Liu,Weikang Shi,Xijie Huang,Linda Wei,Mingjie Zhan,Aojun Zhou,Rui Liu,Hongsheng Li
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin, Hong Kong; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, Shenzhen, China; Centre for Perceptual and Interactive Intelligence (CPII) Ltd, Hong Kong
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher’s internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.

[NLP-5] PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型对齐过程中因偏好标注噪声导致的性能下降问题。现有鲁棒偏好优化方法多在序列层面进行处理，将完整响应视为整体正确或错误，忽略了响应内部存在部分有效信息（如被拒绝响应中的合理推理步骤）或细微错误（如优选响应中的瑕疵）的可能性。为此，本文提出一种细粒度的鲁棒偏好优化框架——基于鲁棒词元级重加权的偏好优化（Preference Optimization via Robust Token-level Reweighting, PORT），其核心在于通过词元级重加权机制，利用词元对数概率的经验累积分布函数（CDF）实现高效、仅前向传播的梯度抑制策略，从而选择性地抑制受污染的词元，避免额外反向传播开销。理论分析表明，PORT通过最小化噪声偏好标签引起的梯度偏差上界，有效降低了偏差。大量实验结果验证了该方法在多种噪声场景下的优越鲁棒性，显著优于现有的序列级基线方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12763
作者: Ding Zhu,Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Zhihui Zhu,Xueru Zhang,Mohammad Mahdi Khalili
机构: The Ohio State University(俄亥俄州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 10 pages, 4 figures, neurips 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbfPreference \textbfOptimization via \textbfRobust \textbfToken-level reweighting \textbf(PORT), a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at this https URL

[NLP-6] Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents : When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决强化学习在语言模型推理中应用时，对多轮序列决策过程的影响机制不清晰的问题，尤其聚焦于临床场景下智能体在信息请求、证据收集终止时机及行动选择等关键决策上的行为表现。其核心挑战在于：仅依赖可验证的最终结果（verifiable final outcomes）进行奖励设计，可能导致模型产生不可靠的推理过程，如过早承诺（premature commitment）、单问题坍缩（one-question collapse）以及对罕见高风险病例的失败响应。解决方案的关键在于引入过程信用（process credit）机制，即为能够降低不确定性的查询动作分配密集的中间奖励，从而引导模型更合理地进行自适应信息获取。实验表明，这种基于不确定性减少的密集过程信用显著提升了模型在中等复杂度病例和罕见高风险病例上的表现，且优于仅依赖最终结果的强化学习方法；进一步将探索与利用分离虽能增强高风险支持，但伴随低严重度病例的信息过量收集。研究还发现，过程信用的最优强度具有任务依赖性，并揭示了监督预热后使用强化学习虽可提升整体奖励，却可能损害高风险场景性能，且无法有效修复由有偏监督数据继承的罕见行为缺陷。因此，论文强调：训练可靠的多轮智能体不仅需关注可验证的最终结果，更必须考虑达成答案的过程路径，评估体系也应区分真正的自适应信息获取与单纯追求奖励的捷径行为。
